title: Corporate Social Responsibility and Consumer Choice: Lessons from the Milk Boycott
authors: In Kyung Kim; Kyoo il Kim
eligible_reason: Single event (Namyang boycott from May 2013, bt = 1 for Namyang products on and after May 2013); analysis is a discrete-choice (logit and random-coefficient) demand model with IV for price, boycott-period dummies bt1-bt6, product, time, region/market dummies and advertising controls, plus counterfactual simulations. No staggered adoption; IV and structural demand estimation.
design_notes: Region-month-product (brand) market shares from NielsenIQ, Jan 2011 - Apr 2014, 16 regions, 34 products.
data_files_note: readme.txt describes data.dta (NielsenIQ sales, Nielsen Media ads), KLIPS draws and figure inputs; no data files are in the package (code and logs only).
